reviews.text: Great place, staff always friendly and professional. My boy loves it there, plus he gets treats..

Our experience was wonderful from beginning with the initial phone call to setup the appointment—Christine was great—to the visit itself—the vet (I cannot recall her name) and vet tech (Kayla, I believe) were amazing. They treated us and our fur baby with the utmost compassion and respect, while spending a considerable amount of time with her and us, making sure all issues were addressed and questions answered.

We also really appreciated them getting the room ready for us when we arrived and making sure the waiting room was as cleared out as possible because our girl is not good with other dogs at all, so the fact that they went above and beyond to accommodate us for that was awesome.

This will definitely be our vet office from now on and we highly recommend them to anyone.
Everyone was very professional.  Moon was treated with care. I appreciate the fact that I was squeezed in despite a very full schedule.
Excellent clinic

Don’t bother calling them! I called to inquire if they can see my sick dog , they told me take her to an emergency vet ? What? So why are they in business? I miss the real original Rockaway animal hospital that used to be on beach 114st! Never had a problem! I just told all my family and friends stay away from this place they don’t need your money !

My dog and I love when we have to go to RockawayBeach Vet. The atmosphere is simply relaxing. The staff are always attentive to my concerns for my dog. My Dog was seen by Dr. Kimberly Starter who is patient and explained every detail to me and helped me to be at eased. Thank you so much for the care.
Sincerely

First of all, there’s nothing more relieving than to know that your pet your fur baby is well taken care of treated with much love and that’s exactly what my fur baby Chanel received on her first visit here.  They can expect a loyal customer forever because the way the Dr and  team treated me and my fur baby was amazing. The Love & Care they put on her not just for her Vaccine appointment, but they took time to care for her and support me on her needs. Questions were answered and I understood what I needed to know for my fur baby to remain healthy.
Thank you so much for absolutely everything Dr Kim, Kayla and Christine. Yall definitely made me feel highly welcomed and safe to make this our place that my fur baby will be well taken care of. Much appreciated and we’re see you soon! :-))

The Rockaway Beach Vet Clinic is the shining star of quality care and animal health services.
Dr. Ruggiero is an indescribably skilled and compassionate doctor; her assessments and diagnosis are thorough and she’s invested in following your pet to ensure that the treatments are effective. All of the other Vets are excellent.
The entire staff is outstanding!
Love u guys🥰 …
Awesome staff

The staff at Rockaway Beach Veterinary Services  are always friendly, caring, and helpful. I continue to bring my fur baby, Valentino, here because they genuinely listen to all my concerns about his health. Dr. Fox and Dr. Sarter are incredible veterinarians, and I truly appreciate the gentle and compassionate way they care for Valentino. My only suggestion would be to bring back grooming services for dogs of all sizes. 🤗

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

There are veterinarians who do their job, and then there are veterinarians who truly care from the heart. Dr.Lori Weinstock  Rockaway Beach Veterinary Services is undeniably one of those special people. She takes the time to listen, she shows genuine compassion, and you can see how deeply she loves every animal in her care.

It’s comforting to know that your beloved pet is being treated by someone who cares for them as if they were her own. Her kindness, patience, dedication, and love are truly remarkable.

She is not only an exceptional veterinarian, but an amazing human being. We are so grateful for everything she does and for the love and care she gives our animals. ❤️🐾

I couldn’t recommend her more highly!!!!
Everyone was so kind and went above and beyond to help my kitty.  Thank you!

**⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Outstanding Veterinarian Care**

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr. Sarter. From the moment we arrived, she was professional, knowledgeable, compassionate, and genuinely caring. She took the time to thoroughly explain every procedure, test, and treatment being performed on my dog, which gave me tremendous peace of mind during a stressful situation.

What impressed me most was her patience and willingness to answer all of my questions. She made sure I understood exactly what was happening and why, and it was clear that she truly cares about the health and well-being of her patients. Her expertise and attention to detail were evident throughout the entire visit.

Dr. Sarter treated my dog with kindness, respect, and exceptional care, and I felt completely confident that my pet was in the best possible hands. The level of professionalism and compassion she provides is truly unmatched.

I highly recommend Dr. Sarter to anyone looking for outstanding veterinary care. In my opinion, she is one of the finest veterinarians in the tri-state area, and I would choose her over any other veterinarian without hesitation. Thank you, Dr. Sarter, for the exceptional care you provided to my beloved dog.

**5 stars without question!** ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
This is the best vet in town!! I have been so pleased with there services, from the front staff to the techs and the Veterinarians ! Everyone is so amazing!
There was hardly any wait time. The staff was so attentive to my Storm. Would definitely recommend.

My dog had pyometra surgery 2 months ago and was in a very bad state and I’ve received the worst customer service when it came to that vulnerable time period with other vets. Coming to this vet was the best decision I could’ve made from the front desk staff to the doctors , they truly have passion and drive to care for animals here. If you’re contemplating a vet to chose from, do not hesitate to come here they’ve made a huge impact on me and my dog and in the best way possible.

Our baby(yorkie) jumped down from the recliner & hurt his back leg. We took him to a Vet in Howard Beach.  They did nothing for the leg but I paid more than $584. Oh,they did medicate pain medication.
Very concerned,not happy & baby still not able to walk properly,we came across RBV.
From making appointment,entering the office & being seen by the tech,it was very pleasant & everyone's concern was our baby.
When Dr.Weinstock came in she was  sensitive to our babies needs. Her care & concern put our worries at ease. We have a journey ahead but we feel with Dr.Weinstock by our side,we'll get thru this hurdle.
Amazing. My dog was having an allergic reaction and they rushed us into the back to treat her before it could get worse. Awesome team all around. Very grateful.
The vet and staff are professional, caring, and attentive to my dog. They always respond promptly and provide excellent care.

I really appreciate the staff at Rockaway Beach Veterinary Service
Thank you
Amazing people!eeal animal lovers!

We switched to Rockaway Beach Veterinary Services and my dog, Maui, was extremely nervous. The staff and doctor were extremely kind to my pup and did everything they could to make her comfortable. We were seen on time and the office is very clean.

Maui was recently brought in when she was not acting herself and I had noticed many changes in her behavior and diet. Dr Ruggiero spent a great deal of time with us evaluating her and letting Maui get to her now as Maui was very nervous and uncomfortable. Once she was diagnosed as in a crisis, Dr. Ruggiero explained the how time was of the essence and once Maui was being treated, the doctor took time to thoroughly explain Maui’s diagnosis and what treatment would look like. Every member of the staff from the receptionists, to the vet techs, to the doctors are all extremely friendly and the office is clean and inviting. I highly recommend Rockaway Beach Veterinary Services to anyone with a pet.

Disgusting! Truly disgusting behavior . These girls are not women….they are little girls . They need to be told how to act to have any consideration.
If your pet is injured or experiencing an emergency, do not bring them here. My experience was beyond disappointing. Instead of showing compassion or urgency, the staff laughed while my animal was hurt, spent time gossiping, and acted as though getting coffee was more important than helping a pet in need. It genuinely felt like my animal could have been dying in front of them, and they showed little concern.
This was, without a doubt, the worst veterinary experience I’ve ever had. When you bring your pet to a vet, you expect empathy, professionalism, and prompt care—not indifference. I would never recommend this clinic to anyone who wants their pet treated with compassion and respect. If you don’t care about your animal come here !!!! For $17 an hour as receptionist’s they act like they own the building . Do better ! Disgusting behavior .

On my recent visit which was MILO'S first it was an amazing one Dr.Ruggiero was so welcoming my Yorkshire Terrier MILO looked like he
knew the doctor for years. THANK YOU so much Dr.Ruggiero and the rest of the staff were excellent.

I want to thank everyone there for being compassionate and making the process of letting my cat go in the most humane decent way. Skittles was more than a pet he was my serenity and friend. Will carry him in my heart forever. Thank you

Dr. Ruggiero has quite literally saved my cats' lives on at least three separate occasions. She possesses a rare blend of patience and expertise, handling my combative girl with grace and humor, comforting my scaredy cat boy with gentle care, and always extending immense kindness to their anxious mom.

That same compassion is mirrored by her incredible office staff and vet techs, who are consistently kind, welcoming, and deeply helpful during every visit.

Through several complex health issues over the years, she has consistently gone above and beyond to ensure my cats receive the most thoughtful, comprehensive care possible. It is entirely obvious that she is just as invested in a positive outcome as any devoted pet owner. Her dedication is unmatched; she has even gone so far as to FaceTime us and check in while away on vacation.

Beyond her exceptional clinical care, she has also been incredibly generous in hosting adoption events for the local rescue I volunteer with.

I cannot recommend her highly enough. If you are looking for a true partner in your pet’s health and well-being, Dr. Ruggiero is the perfect vet.
They were very patient with him. Highly recommend.
The best !!!! Jack is so super hyper and they are all so patient with him. He always gets the care and attention at RBV like hes the superstar of the day ... EVERYTIME!!!
Best vet care

Professional, polite and concern and love for our fur family was genuine.  They made our fur baby relaxed and comfortable.  They made being the only vet on the Rockaway peninsula a blessing.  If you have Veterinary needs go see them first.

Being the proud owners of a Senior Dog, we visit our vet pretty regularly, We are always welcomed by the staff. The vet techs are wonderful with Woody, AND we are TOTALLY in love with Dr. Ruggerio( we have an affectionate nickname for her, but we don’t think she likes it) on the floor, kissing Woody, talking to him like the real person he is, and being SO VERY thorough. We love her!!!!!
I love the fast and friendly service of staff and Dr's. and especially the care they take of my Goldie (cat).

Absolutely a 10!!!!! We are deeply grateful for the outstanding medical care, kindness, and support shown to Bodie and our family. The commitment to their patients is second to none, and we wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone looking for a veterinarian who combines exceptional skill with genuine compassion. The ladies at the front desk were knowledgeable, kind and took the time to answer any questions we had. Thank you all for caring for  Bodie when he needed it most.

They're extremely caring and friendly. The doctors are awesome! I absolutely wouldn't go anywhere else. I go to Rockaway to the vet and I live in Brooklyn. That's how great they are. I've had many doctors in Brooklyn Rockaway Beach veterinary group is the best. I really wouldn't go anywhere else I have four cats and they take care of all of them. Even when I had to put one down the most caring and compassionate place I've ever been to, I would recommend them 100%

I am truly satisfied with the care that we received. The staff was very attentive and communicated well. I felt comfortable and at ease that Chaz was in good hands. The staff was very patient with Chaz and it made a difference in his response.  He was so relaxed.

My dog came into RBVS for a dental cleaning/exam. At first I was apprehensive given the fact she would be under anesthesia. After the consultation with Dr. Gitter-Fox I felt very confident in the quality of care she would receive. She explained the procedure and answered all my questions. Kayla, the vet tech and the front desk staff were all very helpful, kind and patient. The whole experience (from consultation to post-procedure follow up) was excellent. Thank you so much Dr. Gitter-Fox, Kayla, and the RBVS team. Couldn’t ask for more. Highly recommend!!!

I can’t say enough good things about Rockaway Beach Veterinary and most of there team at .  From the moment we walked in, everyone was kind, patient, and genuinely caring toward both me and my pet. When checking in always ask for Ruth. She's very professional, knowledgeable and kind. The other receptionist not so much. Complete opposites. Most of time you come in Ruth is ready to offer best customer service while other receptionist is gossiping on her phone. Doctors and assistants are all friendly. Come to this location, just ask for Ruth and the rest of your visit will be smooth

Honestly could not have asked for a better experience. From the front desk to the tech, to the Dr. My puppy Finn was so comfortable and at ease. For his first visit with vaccinations, they handled him with such love and care which I think had a lot to do with my puppy’s calm, anxiety free experience. Truly one of a kind and treat your pet as one of their own. Highly knowledgeable, Dr and Tech both took time to answer questions and give my puppy quality care. Highly recommend and so happy I chose Rockaway Beach Vet for my puppy’s care.
All of the staff are great. Everyone is so kind and welcoming. You can tell that they truly care and love all of the animals that they see at the clinic!

Everybody at this Veterinary practice is professional and friendly. I have feral cats and they were able to treat them without a problem. Dr. G is a warm and caring Vetinarian. I would definitely recommend bringing your animal to this wonderful facility.
Went to have my cat examined and blood work done and I was very happy with the experience. Caring and sincere vet and support staff. Good luck to you and your pets and good luck to Rockaway Beach.

My dog has been an RBVS patient for 9 years. At the beginning of this year, my pup underwent an enucleation due to glaucoma, and I'd like to share the wonderful experience had at RBVS. Dr. Ruggiero and her team were exceptional. Dr. Ruggiero grasped the urgency immediately, walked us through everything, and scheduled surgery within days. The procedure went well and I was able to take my pet home the same evening. He walked out on his own with the neatest dressing I've ever seen. His recovery was remarkably smooth, with minimal redness and no bleeding or swelling. What truly stood out was the follow-up care. Dr. Ruggiero called the evening after surgery to check in, and other RBVS staff followed up in the days that followed. That's genuine patient care. My dog has now fully recovered, and I can confidently say that for anyone facing this procedure with their pet, I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Ruggiero and RBVS. They are skilled, caring, and truly wonderful to partner with in caring for my furry family member.
Dr. Sarter was kind, she listened, and she did not rush. Just wish my cat was the same with her😆
Verry good servise and attesion
Amazing staff.  Always accommodating. I highly recommend
Everyone was so nice and helpful when I had to bring my Chewy to the urgent care!

Thank you to Drs Weinstock and Sarter for always being compassionate, intelligent and keeping me informed on all of the options I have for caring for my senior dog. I appreciate them more than words can say!!!

This was my first time visiting Dr. Ruggerio  with my very large lab Tony since relocating to NY.  I truly have to say that I have never had a more positive experience visiting a Vet. The care that was given to my dog was exemplary.  The vet was interested in past bloodwork, took time to get to know him before examining him for the reason that I had booked the appointment. I truly have never felt more at ease any other veterinarian. His ailment has been completely taken care of and I am so happy that I have found a Vet that I can trust with my fur baby!!
Amazing Services
Every staff member and all the doctors are so caring and knowledgeable . I am so grateful to have them in our community !
My pup Skylar and I always have the best experience at Rockaway Beach Veterinary Services! The entire staff is so kind, attentive and professional. Thank you so much for all you do!
I am so happy I found you guys. Everyone is amazing from the Vets to the staff. They took great care of my cat, Tommy.
Dr Winstock  was very courteous and kind with Merlot. The technicians were very pleasant and accommodating . Great place for you pup needs

Wanted to share a great review of Rockaway Beach Veterinary services! We’ve been fostering a 5 year old Australian Shepard who is EXTREMELY reactive towards other dogs while on leash  - we are working on it 🙂. I took her for a nail trim and was very worried about a run in with a dog. She goes nuts even just hearing the chain of a leash/collar, let alone if she sees a dog. I called ahead to make sure they understood her reactivity and asked if there was a separate entrance/or if there was a way to have her brought in when no animals were in the waiting area. They assured me they could accommodate us and would have us wait in our car until lobby was clear. A tech met us at the door and Yuna was in and out in 5 minutes. They also double checked with the front desk before bringing Yuna out to make sure there were no other dogs waiting to avoid a reaction. This may seem like standard care, because at RBVS it clearly was seamless and routine, but just wanted to give a shout out and say thank you! Highly recommend

Update on review-
I called asking for an estimate on a spay and neuter. They initially told me I would need to come in for a consultation. I told them I didn’t have a car and due to the snow it was too cold to travel and was just hoping for a range in price. The lady on the phone told me to weigh my kitten and call back with the weight so she could give me an estimate. I BOUGHT A WHOLE SCALE THAT I DID’NT WANT OR NEED TO WEIGH MY KITTEN. Life isnt cheap, I would not buy a scale on my own. After buying this scale and calling back, they told me no I would need to just come in. Now I have a scale that I bought because I was told they would give me a rough estimate if I weighed my kitten. Thanks a lot.
Dr. Gitter-Fox was very thorough, ,knowledgable and caring during my pup’s first visit.

I came in with my Cane Corso, Kaseema, because she was having some urinary distress and accidents in the house. Everyone in the office is so kind and attentive as always. Dr. Gitter-Fox and her veterinary assistant (Elaine) were thorough and explained each test and what it was for and how much it would cost beforehand so there were no surprises at the end. I always have a great experience at Rockaway Beach Vet!

Very nice people, reasonable prices, clean facility,  would recommend for anyone looking for a new vet .my dog can get a bit excited and hyper when it comes to meeting new people, glad I started coming here.
Dr. Ruggerio is such a great Doctor!!!!!

I am very grateful for all of the support me and Daisy are getting over the past two years.  Despite her rare and complicated multiple conditions, she is feeling good again and so am I.  The doctors and the staff all work together for one single goal, to treat their patients.  The front desk is very responsive friendly and patient. Dr Weinstick and Dr Rogiero are amazing, knowledgeable, gentle and patient (I have a cat). Unfortunately I have never met the third doctor, but his knowledge has been mentioned during out multiple visits. Thank you, for all that you do, it matters

Always a great experience. So professional, but warm and caring. Started bringing my dog two years ago; he is ten. They are soooo much better than the vets we used when we lived on Long Island.  Highly recommend.
We found the staff at Rockaway Beach Veterinary Services to be professional, caring and helpful. We’re very happy to have found them.
Excellent care and service.

Dr. Ruggiero is the best vet! She’s so kind and really cares about all animals. Also, big shout out to Kayla and Elijah who were the best vet tech and assistant!! My dog is 120lbs and she doesn’t like going to the vet — trying to get her blood drawn is like trying to wrestle a baby bull but they did it seamlessly and effortlessly! 100% recommend!!
Not happy at all. Please bring your loved fur babies somewhere else.
I take my 4 fur babies here and wouldn’t trade this vet for the world ❤️ they’re are true wonderful and very caring, patient, and helpful with each of my pets individual needs.
The doctors and staff are wonderful.  Took very good care of my puppy(12yrs) .  Would highly recommend using them.
We received service for a yeast infection and a great job was done,  he's been doing well 👍

I had an incredible experience with this clinic! The entire staff was so helpful, friendly, and genuinely kind from the moment we walked in. The Doctor was amazing—she took the time to explain everything thoroughly regarding the vaccines and tests, which I truly appreciated. The veterinary assistant was also very helpful throughout the visit. I highly recommend this team to any pet owner!

Horrible horrible and disgusted with this place. My dog was taken from me and when I asked for my personal information on my dog they wouldn’t give it to me . These people are the worst kind. Hopefully they get shut down for how they treat people. Horrible practice.
Courteous, knowledgeable, affordable, very caring and engaged.
They were so nice, thank you for all your help in my hour of need . We'll be back
Dr. Sarter is the best. She was so caring, careful, and very thorough.  She took excellent care treating Daisy's ankle area. She also nakes sure you understand everything from beginning to end!!! ❤️

Dr. Sarter was amazing! I have never been happier with the care my fur baby received. The entire staff and the techs were outstanding—so caring, patient, and attentive. Everyone took their time with Giuseppe and made sure I felt heard and supported throughout the visit. I truly felt that my dog’s exam was done with intentional time, compassion, and genuine care. I couldn’t ask for a better veterinary team!
Love this place took good care of my Dog staff very professional and price is fair highly recommended 👍🏻 …
Caring and compassionate Veterinary Office.  Dr. Ruggiero is wonderful.

10/10 everyone here is so nice. Dr. Gitter-Fox is amazing. She is so patient and helpful and really goes above and beyond. Taking your fur babies to the vet is never fun but having a Dr. like her makes the situation so much more comforting. Thank you Dr. Gitter-Fox!
OUTSTANDING!

Rockaway Beach  veterinary services has always taking care of my dog Remy. This past Thanksgiving right after his ninth birthday I had to put him to sleep due to cancer of the prostate bladder and kidney. The staff and Dr Ruggerio were so  kind compassionate caring and understanding. Even as she administered the medication they were tears in her eyes. I think my Remmy was licking her face as if to thank her for taking away the pain. From the minute I thought he was ill she made an allowance for me to come in early to x-ray him. Right away told me she suspected something and set up an appointment  for a sonogram.   I still haven’t gotten over the loss of my Remy as I had no children and he was my child. But if I should get another dog he or she will not go anywhere but Rockaway Beach veterinary services. I highly recommend them they were caring compassionate dedicated and knowledgeable team.
Excellent service as always. Second pet and always a pleasure coming here.

Dr. Kimberly Sarter is highly esteemed. She exhibits utmost professionalism and extensive knowledge. Furthermore, the staff members are likewise very professional and compassionate. Thank you once again.
Staff is always welcoming and helpful with my pet.

Dr. Weinstock and her assistant (sorry I didn’t catch her name) were so gentle and yet thorough with our 14 year-old “baby. “ The doctor made every effort to explain all as she examined our pup and was very receptive and respectful of my preferences as to a care plan. Much appreciation!

Awesome pet vet services! Its very courteous and diligent staff got us through the process to obtain an international travel health certificate. From the initial contact, appointment setup and paperwork filing, through the check up itself and thoroughly taking care of all the details within the proper time window prior to the trip, it all went SO smoothly. We contacted them Sept 24th, made the appointment for Oct 28, got the certificate in the mail on Oct 30, and will travel Nov 5. The cost? it all depends on where you are traveling, as the health requirements vary, we didn't really need any extra testing but just a confirmation all his vax, microchip, etc. were current. The cost also includes standard USDA fees, so the original estimate of $400-$500 for a 15 lbs. 2y/o dog traveling to Spain was quite accurate. Thank you so much to Dr. Ruggiero for being so sweet but thorough with our pup! Thank you Chastity, Christine and our super nice technician (Cayley?) who efficiently and very professionally assisted with all the process. I recommend this place to anyone that wants to have their pet taken care of in the most professional and caring way.
Every one at the office treat you with respect. They do care about your pet and and it’s wellbeing, and gives advice where possible also commends you for taking care of your pet.
Fabulous experience w Dr Maya Gitter-fox as well as the staff.  They were kind, attentive and available!  Most importantly my 16 yr old pug was cared for and is now on the mend!  Thank you RBV .  😊 …
The service is pretty fast, ☺️ Tammy is doing better, I'm pleased with the outcome
Great experience, doctors are top notch.

I have entrusted RBVS with all of my fur babies through the years.  There is Noone better.  They love and care for your animals as if they were their own.  They are highly skilled, patient, and caring. From the front desk to the Doctors. Even my fur babies look forward to their visits!!

I am very grateful to Dr. Ruggiero and everyone there for being so understanding , intelligent and compassionate. I feel like the decisions I am making for our cats are well thought out, so I am confident they are getting the best care . It really means a lot that the whole staff is understanding of each cat's situation  ( and I have a lot of cats that might be considered "misfits" or "unadoptable" from my work with a rescue group. ) No BS - just very smart and super kind which means a lot- so thank you all and lots of love.
Everyone was so pleasant and attentive.  My two boys know we are at the Vet, but dont get scared and its because they know they are being well taken care of. friendly staff and doctors are awesome.

Dr Maya Gitter Fox is knowledgeable and attentive to my pet’s needs. She is accessible and communicative with me especially in times of emergency situations.

The staff at the vet is friendly, helpful and respectful.

Their appointment booking system is very user friendly. They send reminders to ensure that we do not miss our appointment.

We are so lucky we have a local professional veterinarian on the peninsula who knows us and our pet on a first name basis.
The Doctor and your assistant very nice Explain everything. Give a lot love for my dog Sandy Thank you so much I recommend

My experience with Vet Ms. Ruggiero was very pleasant, she is very knowledgeable veterinarian. I will highly recommend her. She is very patience with my dog Bambi.
And her prices are very reasonable.
I was able to get Bambi health certificate so we can fly with him to Puerto Rico. Everything went smoothly.
Very attentive, compassionate and supportive. Love the team at RBVS and so does Max  🥰❤️ …
The girl that attended the phone is very rude.

The experience was fantastic from reservation , check in , exam and checking out.
Thank you
The staff was professional and friendly. But billing and cost of service is horrendous and overpriced.

I had a wonderful experience at Rockaway Beach Veterinary Services with my 3-year-old rescue dog, Coco. From the moment we arrived, the front desk staff was welcoming, friendly, and helpful. The veterinary team was exceptionally kind and gentle with Coco, which made the visit stress-free for both of us.

I was especially impressed by the veterinarian and her assistant, who got down on the floor to examine Coco—such a thoughtful and compassionate approach. They also took the time to thoroughly explain new findings in canine care, which I greatly appreciated.

It was also convenient that Coco could receive a single injection covering all of her necessary vaccines. It’s clear that everyone at this clinic truly loves what they do and genuinely cares for animals of all kinds. I’m so glad to have found such a caring and professional local vet. Highly recommended!
Great care.
They took very good care of our cat.
Love this place! The doctors and staff are so kind and caring!

I have been taking my dogs (4 dogs now)  here for years.  Different breeds and ages. The care my pets and family receives is always exceptional. Clear communication, prompt responses and appointments are always easy. The staff is pleasant, professional and kid friendly. We love this place.
We always have a great experience at Rockaway Beach Vet Service!
They are amazing at what they do!!!!
The staff at Rockaway Beach veterinary services are empathetic and very professional a combination of ultimate importance to a pet owner.
Excellent, very good service, they treated my pet with a lot of love and care
We love the team at Rockaway Beach Veterinary Services—the care our dog receives is top-notch.
Excellent excellent excellent
My most recent visits to Rockaway Vet have been really really good. Everyone is deeply knowledgeable and caring.
The staff were friendly, professional and caring.
I absolutely love rockaway Beach veterinary! The prices are great. The staff is amazing! They are great with the pets and owner. I will always bring my dogs to this vet. THANK YOU ROCKAWAY VETERINARY

I have 4 pets that I bring on a semi regular basis, they provide quality care with friendly and knowledgeable staff!  I have been going for years and have never had an issue.  They book up quickly and occasionally have delays  between appointments, so keep that in mind when you schedule! (And remember be patient if your appointment is a little delayed —the level of quality they provide sometimes needs a little extra time during visits. I’ve never waited longer than 10 mins or so,  and they always let me know / check in while I wait).
From front desk to the dr. They all were very nice and knowledgeable.
Caring loving staff who answer all questions and have a sincere love for keeping our furry family members safe and healthy!
The staff is professional... friendly and caring... as well as patient
Excellent and caring pet care with knowledgeable and lovely practitioners.
Professional and friendly environment, i feel that my furry baby is in good hands.

I took my baby in for a checkup, and not only did they advise me on the most cost-effective option, but they were also kind, helpful, and made it a pleasant experience. I’m truly thankful that this vet cares more about helping you and your animal than making money. Truly a wonderful business and i whole-heartedly recommend them.

I HARDLY EVER GIVE REVIEWS. I FEEL SO PASSIONATE ABOUT THIS CLINIC THAT I JUST HAD TO EXPRESS MY GRATITUDE. A FAMILY LIKE ATMOSPHERE, THE DOCTORS ARE VERY PROFESSIONAL AND TAKE THE TIME TO EXPLAIN THINGS AND ANSWER QUESTIONS AND CONCERNS. THEY TAKE GREAT CARE OF YOUR BELOVED PETS. I'VE BEEN A PET OWNER FOR OVER 35 YEARS AND THIS IS PROPABLY THE BEST CLINIC I'VE BEEN A PART OF. MY 2 GOLDEN RETRIEVERS AND 3 SYBERIAN CATS ARE VERY HAPPY HERE. A FULL SERVICE ANIMAL CLINIC.
Service was good but very costly! Be ready to spend quite a bit!

I can’t say enough good things about this clinic!  They took such amazing care of my dog, Bonia, and treated her like one of their own. From the moment we walked in, the staff was kind, professional, and clearly passionate about animals.

Thanks to their expert care, my dog is healthy, happy, and back to his playful self after the surgeries. I highly recommend Dr. Joanne and Dr. Maya to any pet owner looking for compassionate, top-quality veterinary care<3

I love Rockaway Beach Veterinary Services!  My fur baby Bella had dental surgery with tooth extraction and was treated like she was their own fur baby their kindness and caring shows every day all my fur babies love them it’s the only place to take they. To Animal Owners everywhere:
It is with great enthusiasm that my wife, Kate, and I recommend Dr. Joanne Ruggerio, DVM and the exceptional team at Rockaway Beach Veterinary Services. As devoted dog owners of two Cane Corso’s (Tiberius and Calliope), we have entrusted Dr. Ruggerio with the health and well-being of our dogs for the past eight years, and we could not be more satisfied with the care provided.
Dr. Ruggerio’s medical expertise is evident in the outstanding treatment our dogs have received. Beyond meeting the standard expectations of a veterinarian, Dr. Ruggerio goes above and beyond by providing thoughtful and detailed medical recommendations. Her ability to explain the pros and cons of various vaccines, tailored to our specific day-to-day interactions with our dogs, has been incredibly valuable. Her approach ensures that we, as pet owners, feel well-informed and confident in the decisions we make for our canine companions.
Additionally, Dr. Ruggerio demonstrates an exceptional commitment to specialized care. On the occasions where our dogs have needed advanced treatments—be it surgery, orthopedics, or neurology—Dr. Ruggerio has provided expert advice and referred us to outstanding specialists. Her dedication and guidance have made navigating these situations far less daunting.
In every interaction, Dr. Ruggerio and her team at Rockaway Beach Veterinary Services have shown professionalism, compassion, and a genuine passion for animal care. And they give/hand out great treats.  We wholeheartedly recommend their services to any pet owner seeking a knowledgeable and attentive veterinary practice.
